hints.text: Try renaming the decimal using its smallest place. A number of tenths can be shared just like a whole number.
$4.8$ is $48$ tenths. Share those tenths into $6$ equal groups by working out $48 \div 6$.
$48 \div 6 = 8$, and $8$ tenths is $0.8$, so the quotient $4.8 \div 6$ is $0.8$.

explanation: Rename the dividend in tenths: $4.8 = 48$ tenths.
Split those tenths into $6$ equal groups: $48 \div 6 = 8$, so each group has $8$ tenths.
$8$ tenths written as a decimal is $0.8$, so $4.8 \div 6 = 0.8$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Check by multiplying back
steps: Guess the quotient from the fact $48 \div 6 = 8$: since $4.8$ is ten times smaller than $48$, try $0.8$.
Test it: $0.8 \times 6$ is $8$ tenths six times, which is $48$ tenths.
Forty-eight tenths is $4.8$, the starting number, so $4.8 \div 6 = 0.8$.
